text: DSH WorkBuddy 是面向 DSH 网页端的 WorkBuddy 账户与模型接入插件。它在 DSH 注册 WorkBuddy 模型 provider，并在设置页提供账户连接、状态查看和模型目录界面。用户可以通过浏览器完成账户授权，查看额度与套餐信息，按名称或模型 ID 搜索模型，并选择支持工具调用的模型进行流式对话。设置页还提供刷新和断开账户连接操作。适合已经部署 DSH、希望在现有会话中使用 WorkBuddy 模型并管理账户连接的用户。需要 WorkBuddy 账户、单独运行的 Python 服务与认证 gateway，并配置 gateway 地址和凭据文件。

DSH WorkBuddy connects a WorkBuddy account to DSH web. Users can sign in, view credits, search models, and refresh or disconnect in Settings. Select a model for streamed chats and tool calls. It needs a WorkBuddy account, Python service, authenticated gateway, URL, and credential-file settings.

**Connect your WorkBuddy account to DeepSeek Harness. See your credits, compare available models, and use them in your DSH conversations.**

An independent community plugin for the DSH web profile. **Self-hosted alpha**, for people who already run DSH and can operate a separate Python service and authenticated gateway. No hosted service or official WorkBuddy/DeepSeek endorsement is claimed.
dsh-workbuddy README · DSH WorkBuddy：[Start here](#quickstart) · [Deployment guide](deploy/README.md) · [Security and data handling](SECURITY.md) · [Report a problem](SUPPORT.md)

dsh-workbuddy README · What You Get：- **Account and credit visibility in DSH:** browser sign-in, connection status, remaining credits, and package expiry dates in Settings → WorkBuddy.
- **A clearer model choice:** search by name or ID, distinguish same-name routes, compare credit multipliers and capabilities, and filter models explicitly marked free by upstream billing or active promotions. The catalog includes account models that support tool calls.
- **Your existing DSH workflow:** select the WorkBuddy provider for streamed responses and tool-call workflows. No WorkBuddy desktop process needs to remain running after browser authorization.

dsh-workbuddy README · What You Get：This plugin is independent of the A2D2 orchestration and DimAgent plugins. The [screenshots](#screenshots) show the current interface; the [operations guide](docs/OPERATIONS.md) covers acceptance and recovery.

dsh-workbuddy README · Before You Connect：- **Confirm permission for this integration.** WorkBuddy's [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.workbuddy.ai/document/acceptable-use-policy), sections 3.5 and 4, restricts automated access and requires prior written permission for interoperating plugins and external components. Review the applicable [Service Agreement](https://www.workbuddy.ai/document/term) and confirm permission before use. A successful browser login does not establish approval for a third-party client.
- **One service, one shared account.** Each Python service owns one WorkBuddy account. Authenticated users of the same DSH instance share its credits and account controls. There is no tenant isolation; use separate deployments for separate trust boundaries, subject to upstream account rules.
- **Free labels are conditional.** Models, promotions, expiry and usage limits depend on your account and upstream rules. The plugin grants no extra credits or unlimited access. All provider numeric cost fields currently contain zero; those fields are not evidence of free inference. See [pricing and limits](#pricing-and-limits).

dsh-workbuddy README · Prerequisites：| You need | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| An existing DSH web installation | Local review used DSH packages `0.2.0-rc.2`; the broader peer range is not a tested compatibility matrix |
| Node.js and pnpm | Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`; pnpm `10.4.1` is selected by `packageManager`; use the committed lockfile |
| A Python service host | Python `>=3.10`, `uv`, the pinned `workbuddy2api` source, and a persistent service manager; dependencies are locked in this plugin |
| An authenticated gateway | Authenticate every forwarded route, strip the gateway bearer key, and use HTTPS between hosts; keep Python on loopback |
| An eligible WorkBuddy account | Confirm that the intended third-party access is permitted and that the account offers a suitable model |

dsh-workbuddy README · Prerequisites：This is a source-based setup with multiple components. The repository includes a [Caddy gateway configuration](deploy/Caddyfile), [environment example](deploy/gateway.env.example), and [Supervisor example](deploy/workbuddy2api.conf). Adapt and verify them before connecting an account.

dsh-workbuddy README · From Source to Your First Conversation：1. **Build the plugin** with the commands in [Install](#install).
2. **Prepare the backend** at the pinned upstream revision and configure its private credential/log paths. Follow [Service](#service) and the ordered [deployment guide](deploy/README.md#first-time-setup).
3. **Secure and connect the gateway.** Verify that missing and incorrect credentials are rejected before installing the plugin into your DSH profile. Set `gatewayBaseURL` and `gatewayKeyFile` as shown below.
4. **Authorize in DSH.** Open Settings → WorkBuddy, choose **Connect WorkBuddy**, then **Open sign-in page**. Complete browser authorization and return to the original settings page. Confirm **Connected**, the catalog, and your credit details; use **Refresh** to reload them.
5. **Try a small conversation.** Select an available model under the **WorkBuddy** provider. For DeepSeek, search the catalog for `DeepSeek` and check the exact model ID, billing and promotion expiry first. Send a short prompt, then verify a read-only tool-call round trip. Inference can consume credits.

text: dsh-workbuddy README · From Source to Your First Conversation：Success means the settings page shows your account, the selected model streams a reply, and a tool result returns to the same conversation. A connected status alone does not verify inference. If a step fails, use the [common checks](SUPPORT.md#common-checks); do not remove gateway authentication to troubleshoot.

dsh-workbuddy README · How It Works：```text
DSH web UI → DSH host plugin → authenticated gateway → loopback Python service → WorkBuddy
```

dsh-workbuddy README · How It Works：The host plugin reuses DSH's `PiAiAdapter`. The separately supervised Python service imports the pinned [workbuddy2api](https://github.com/Zhengyuuuui/workbuddy2api) implementation for streaming and tool-call protocol conversion. WorkBuddy tokens stay on the service host; the browser receives an authorization link and account information. Prompts, conversation history and tool data are sent upstream for inference. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the full data flow and retention boundaries.

dsh-workbuddy README · Screenshots：Captured from the plugin's Chinese interface. Account identity, balances, and package expiry dates are redacted. Model availability, multipliers, and promotions reflect the capture date and may change.
dsh-workbuddy README · Model Search：Duplicate display names retain their distinct model IDs and billing information.
dsh-workbuddy README · Free Models：Free labels come from explicit upstream billing data and active promotions.

dsh-workbuddy README · Pricing and Limits：**Does this provide free DeepSeek access?** Only upstream can determine your account's eligibility, billing and permitted access. Some model IDs may have temporary promotions; check the account's current model ID, credit multiplier, expiry and usage limits. A screenshot, an October promotion elsewhere, or a zero cost estimate in DSH is not a promise that a request through this integration is free.

dsh-workbuddy README · Pricing and Limits：**What does “Free only” mean?** It filters explicit zero-credit billing or an active upstream promotion that explicitly reduces that model's credit cost to zero. Unknown pricing stays unknown. This filter does not verify your remaining promotional allowance or override daily limits, rate limits or upstream terms. Check your WorkBuddy account for authoritative billing and entitlements; unavailable credit data does not mean a zero balance.

dsh-workbuddy README · Install：Check the [prerequisites](#prerequisites) first. Clone and build the source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/a2d2-dev/dsh-workbuddy.git
cd dsh-workbuddy
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

After the service and authenticated gateway are ready, install the bundle into your existing DSH web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy
```

Configure the entry in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

dsh-workbuddy README · Install：```yaml
- id: workbuddy
  config:
    gatewayBaseURL: https://workbuddy-gateway.example.com
    gatewayKeyFile: /absolute/path/to/workbuddy-gateway-key

dsh-workbuddy README · Install：Replace the example domain and absolute paths with your deployment values. The key file contains the gateway's bearer credential, with no environment-variable assignment. Do not place upstream tokens in DSH configuration or source control. The gateway endpoint must be protected by authentication; the Python listener should remain on loopback behind that gateway.

dsh-workbuddy README · Service：Requires Python 3.10+ and uv. Check out [workbuddy2api](https://github.com/Zhengyuuuui/workbuddy2api) at revision `1cc32c9a98abb53796d8d4e8d477736fe1f0c4cc`. In this plugin directory, install the locked service dependencies with `uv sync --frozen --no-dev`, then run `.venv/bin/uvicorn --app-dir server workbuddy_service:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18788`. Set the following environment variables through the service supervisor:

dsh-workbuddy README · Service：| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `WORKBUDDY_PROXY_SOURCE` | Checkout of the pinned upstream repository |
| `WORKBUDDY_ENDPOINT` | WorkBuddy backend origin, normally `https://www.workbuddy.ai` |
| `WORKBUDDY_SESSION_FILE` | Private, writable credential file; existing proxy sessions are accepted |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOGIN_TTL_SECONDS` | Authorization expiry in seconds, normally `300` |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOG_FILE` | Protocol summary log path |

dsh-workbuddy README · Service：Use Supervisor or another persistent service manager, with a single service worker to own the account and its pending login. Refresh is serialized, and credential updates use atomic file replacement. Sign-out removes this service's authorization without revoking other devices. An expired login can be restarted from Settings. The gateway access key is deployment authentication, distinct from WorkBuddy account authorization.

dsh-workbuddy README · Verify：Run `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm check:package` (builds and verifies the distributable). For service tests run `uv sync --frozen`, then `PYTHONPATH=/absolute/path/to/workbuddy2api/server uv run --frozen pytest`. Install Caddy to include the real gateway integration tests. CI covers Node.js 22/24 and Python 3.10/3.14. Live acceptance additionally requires DSH settings rendering, an authorized account, streamed text, and a tool-call round trip.

dsh-workbuddy README · Compatibility and Community：- Settings support English and Simplified Chinese, including model descriptions and promotion text when supplied by upstream. Provider model names use an English free label; the current screenshots show Chinese.
- The documented DSH baseline is `0.2.0-rc.2`. A wider peer-dependency range does not establish compatibility with every later release; repeat live acceptance after host or upstream changes.
- [Contributing and local verification](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Support and bug reports](SUPPORT.md) · [Service operation and recovery](docs/OPERATIONS.md)

dsh-workbuddy README · Remove：Remove this bundle through the DSH plugin manager and stop its dedicated services. Existing DSH providers and sessions are unaffected. WorkBuddy credentials are retained on disk unless signed out before removal.
dsh-workbuddy README · License：Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). The separately installed upstream project retains its own license.

dsh-workbuddy README · DSH WorkBuddy：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**在 DeepSeek Harness 里连接 WorkBuddy 账号，查看额度、比较可用模型，并直接用于 DSH 对话。**

面向 DSH web profile 的独立社区插件。当前为 **自托管 Alpha**，适合已有 DSH、能够维护 Python 服务与鉴权网关的用户。本项目不提供托管服务，也不主张获得 WorkBuddy 或 DeepSeek 的官方背书。

[开始使用](#快速上手) · [部署指南](deploy/README.md) · [安全与数据处理](SECURITY.md) · [问题反馈](SUPPORT.md)

dsh-workbuddy README · 能帮你做什么：- **在 DSH 里看清账号与额度：**通过浏览器登录，在「设置 → WorkBuddy」查看连接状态、Credits 余额和各额度包到期时间。
- **更容易选对模型：**按名称或 ID 搜索，区分同名入口，比较 Credits 倍率与能力，筛选上游计费或有效活动明确标为免费的模型。目录仅纳入账号可用且支持工具调用的模型。
- **沿用 DSH 的工作流：**在 WorkBuddy provider 下选择模型，使用流式响应与工具调用。浏览器授权完成后，无需持续运行 WorkBuddy 桌面客户端。

本插件独立于 A2D2 和 DimAgent 插件。[界面截图](#界面截图)展示当前体验，验收和恢复步骤见[运行手册](docs/OPERATIONS.md)。

dsh-workbuddy README · 连接前请确认：- **第三方集成的许可：**WorkBuddy [可接受使用政策](https://www.workbuddy.ai/document/acceptable-use-policy)第 3.5、4 节限制自动化访问，并要求互操作插件及外部组件事先取得书面许可。请结合适用的[服务协议](https://www.workbuddy.ai/document/term)确认该接入方式获准后再使用。浏览器登录成功，不等于平台批准了第三方客户端。
- **一个服务共享一个账号：**每个 Python 服务管理一个 WorkBuddy 账号，同一 DSH 实例的已认证用户共享其额度和账号控制。当前没有租户隔离；不同信任边界应独立部署，并遵守上游账号规则。
- **免费状态有条件：**模型、活动、有效期及用量限制以上游账号规则为准，插件不会增加额度或提供无限使用。当前 provider 的数值成本字段对所有模型均填零，不能据此判断免费。详见[费用与限制](#费用与限制)。

dsh-workbuddy README · 前置条件：| 需要准备 | 检查要点 |
| --- | --- |
| 已运行的 DSH web 环境 | 本地评估使用 DSH 包 `0.2.0-rc.2`；更宽的 peer-dependency 范围不等于已验证兼容范围 |
| Node.js 与 pnpm | Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；按 `packageManager` 使用 pnpm `10.4.1` 与仓库锁文件 |
| Python 服务主机 | Python `>=3.10`、`uv`、固定版本的 `workbuddy2api` 源码与常驻服务管理器；依赖由本插件锁定 |
| 鉴权网关 | 每个转发路由都需鉴权，转发时剥离网关 Bearer 凭据，跨主机使用 HTTPS；Python 仅监听回环地址 |
| 符合条件的 WorkBuddy 账号 | 确认第三方接入获准，且账号提供适用模型 |
dsh-workbuddy README · 前置条件：当前需要从源码部署多个组件。仓库已提供 [Caddy 鉴权网关配置](deploy/Caddyfile)、[环境变量示例](deploy/gateway.env.example)与 [Supervisor 示例](deploy/workbuddy2api.conf)；连接账号前，请按自己的环境配置并验证。

dsh-workbuddy README · 从源码到第一条对话：1. **构建插件：**执行下方[安装](#安装)中的源码构建命令。
2. **准备后端：**检出固定版本的上游项目，设置私有凭据与日志路径。按照[服务部署](#服务部署)及[首次部署步骤](deploy/README.md#first-time-setup)配置。
3. **验证并连接网关：**先确认缺失和错误凭据都会被拒绝，再将插件安装到 DSH profile，配置 `gatewayBaseURL` 和 `gatewayKeyFile`。
4. **在 DSH 中授权：**进入「设置 → WorkBuddy」，点击「登录 WorkBuddy」和「打开登录页」，完成浏览器授权后回到原设置页。确认显示「已连接」、模型清单和额度信息，必要时点击「刷新」。
5. **测试一条简短对话：**在 **WorkBuddy** provider 下选择可用模型。如果要用 DeepSeek，先在目录搜索 `DeepSeek`，核对具体模型 ID、计费信息和活动截止时间。先发一条简短提示，再验证一次只读工具调用与结果回传。测试可能消耗额度。
dsh-workbuddy README · 从源码到第一条对话：成功标准是设置页显示账号、选中的模型能流式回复、工具结果能回到同一对话。仅显示「已连接」不足以证明推理可用。遇到问题请查看[常见检查项](SUPPORT.md#common-checks)，不要通过关闭网关鉴权排障。

dsh-workbuddy README · 工作方式：```text
DSH 网页 → DSH 主机插件 → 鉴权网关 → 回环地址上的 Python 服务 → WorkBuddy
```

模型请求复用 DSH 的 `PiAiAdapter`。独立运行的 Python 服务引用固定版本的 [workbuddy2api](https://github.com/Zhengyuuuui/workbuddy2api)，处理流式响应和工具调用协议转换。WorkBuddy Token 保存在服务端，浏览器只接收授权链接和账号信息；提示词、对话历史及工具数据会发送给上游进行推理。完整数据流与保留边界见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。
dsh-workbuddy README · 界面截图：截图中的账号、实际额度和额度到期时间均已脱敏。模型可用性、倍率和免费活动以账号实时返回的数据为准，截图不代表长期定价承诺。
dsh-workbuddy README · 账号与 Credits 额度：查看连接状态、可用模型数、免费模型数，以及各额度包的余额和到期时间。
dsh-workbuddy README · 搜索模型：支持按名称或 ID 搜索。同名模型保留不同的 ID，并分别展示 Credits 倍率、上下文、最大输出和能力。
dsh-workbuddy README · 免费模型筛选：勾选「仅看免费」筛选当前明确免费的模型。免费状态来自上游计费字段和有效期内的活动；未知价格不会被当作免费。

dsh-workbuddy README · 费用与限制：**能免费使用 DeepSeek 吗？** 账号资格、计费与允许的接入方式由上游决定。部分模型 ID 可能有临时活动，请核对账号当前返回的模型 ID、Credits 倍率、截止时间及用量限制。截图、其他渠道的十月活动或 DSH 中的零成本估算，都不能保证通过本插件发出的请求免费。

**「仅看免费」代表什么？** 它筛选上游明确的零 Credits 计费，或将该模型 Credits 费用明确降为零的有效活动，未知价格不会被当作免费。筛选结果不验证剩余活动次数，也不会覆盖每日上限、速率限制或服务条款。权威计费及权益请以 WorkBuddy 账号为准；额度「未提供」不等于余额为零。

dsh-workbuddy README · 安装：先核对[前置条件](#前置条件)，再克隆并构建源码：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/a2d2-dev/dsh-workbuddy.git
cd dsh-workbuddy
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

服务与鉴权网关准备就绪后，安装到已有 DSH web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy
```

在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置：

```yaml
- id: workbuddy
  config:
    gatewayBaseURL: https://workbuddy-gateway.example.com
    gatewayKeyFile: /absolute/path/to/workbuddy-gateway-key
dsh-workbuddy README · 安装：以上域名和路径是示例，需替换为自己的部署配置。密钥文件只包含网关的 Bearer 凭据，不要写成环境变量赋值语句。不要把 WorkBuddy 授权 Token 写入 DSH 配置或提交到仓库。网关必须启用鉴权，Python 服务应只监听回环地址，并由网关转发。

dsh-workbuddy README · 服务部署：需要 Python 3.10+ 和 uv。单独检出上游项目并切换到版本 `1cc32c9a98abb53796d8d4e8d477736fe1f0c4cc`。在本插件目录执行 `uv sync --frozen --no-dev` 安装锁定的服务依赖，再通过本插件的虚拟环境启动：

```sh
/absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy/.venv/bin/uvicorn \
  --app-dir /absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy/server \
  workbuddy_service:create_app --factory \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18788

通过 Supervisor 等服务管理器配置以下环境变量：

dsh-workbuddy README · 服务部署：| 变量 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `WORKBUDDY_PROXY_SOURCE` | 固定版本的上游项目目录 |
| `WORKBUDDY_ENDPOINT` | WorkBuddy 后端地址，通常为 `https://www.workbuddy.ai` |
| `WORKBUDDY_SESSION_FILE` | 私有、可写的凭据文件路径，也可读取已有代理会话 |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOGIN_TTL_SECONDS` | 授权流程有效时间，单位秒，通常为 `300` |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOG_FILE` | 协议摘要日志路径 |

使用单个服务 worker 管理账号及待完成的登录流程。Token 刷新采用串行处理，凭据通过原子替换写入。退出登录会移除本服务保存的授权，不会撤销其他设备。授权链接过期后，可在设置中重新发起登录。网关访问密钥与 WorkBuddy 账号授权是两套独立凭据。
dsh-workbuddy README · 服务部署：更多部署示例见 [部署指南](deploy/README.md) 和 [Supervisor 配置示例](deploy/workbuddy2api.conf)。部署更新后，应重新加载已有浏览器标签页，确认插件前端已更新。

dsh-workbuddy README · 验证：```sh
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm check:package
```

Python 测试使用本插件的锁定依赖，并将上游的 `server` 目录加入 `PYTHONPATH`。安装 Caddy 后会同时运行真实网关的鉴权及凭据剥离测试：

```sh
uv sync --frozen
PYTHONPATH=/absolute/path/to/workbuddy2api/server uv run --frozen pytest
```

CI 覆盖 Node.js 22/24 和 Python 3.10/3.14。`pnpm check:package` 会构建并检查实际发布包；真实账号验收还需检查 DSH 设置页、账号授权、流式文本，以及完整的工具调用与结果回传。
